workflow_id: rag_draft_response_generation
steps:
  - id: step_authenticate_agent
    op: authenticate_user
    params:
      role: "support_agent"
    output: auth_result

  - id: step_receive_email
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      endpoint: "/api/email/classified_thread"
    output: raw_email_data

  - id: step_validate_email
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_email_data
      schema: classified_email_schema
    output: validated_email

  - id: step_extract_email_body
    op: extract_field
    params:
      input: validated_email
      field: "email_body"
    output: email_body

  - id: step_extract_thread_history
    op: extract_field
    params:
      input: validated_email
      field: "thread_history"
    output: thread_history

  - id: step_search_all_knowledge_bases
    op: parallel_execute
    params:
      steps:
        - step_search_support_docs
        - step_search_club_documents
        - step_search_previous_emails

  - id: step_search_support_docs
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      endpoint: "/api/knowledge_base/customerSupportDocs/search"
      query_input: email_body
    output: raw_support_docs

  - id: step_search_club_documents
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      endpoint: "/api/knowledge_base/clubDocuments/search"
      query_input: email_body
    output: raw_club_docs

  - id: step_search_previous_emails
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      endpoint: "/api/knowledge_base/previousEmailResponses/search"
      query_input: email_body
    output: raw_previous_emails

  - id: step_validate_support_docs
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_support_docs
      schema: knowledge_base_result_schema
    output: validated_support_docs

  - id: step_validate_club_docs
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_club_docs
      schema: knowledge_base_result_schema
    output: validated_club_docs

  - id: step_validate_previous_emails
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_previous_emails
      schema: knowledge_base_result_schema
    output: validated_previous_emails

  - id: step_merge_support_and_club
    op: merge_datasets
    params:
      input: validated_support_docs
      secondary_input: validated_club_docs
      key: "topic"
    output: merged_support_club

  - id: step_merge_all_sources
    op: merge_datasets
    params:
      input: merged_support_club
      secondary_input: validated_previous_emails
      key: "topic"
    output: all_knowledge_results

  - id: step_detect_language_and_season
    op: apply_rule
    params:
      input: email_body
      rules:
        - rule: "detect_language"
          options: ["EN", "FR", "ES"]
        - rule: "season_mapping"
          description: "Map current date to activity season"
    output: language_and_season

  - id: step_apply_date_awareness
    op: transform_json
    params:
      input: all_knowledge_results
      mapping:
        date_context: "current_date"
        filter_current_activities: true
        season_info: language_and_season
    output: date_aware_knowledge

  - id: step_draft_response
    op: call_subworkflow
    params:
      workflow_id: "ai_draft_composer"
      email_body: email_body
      thread_history: thread_history
      knowledge_context: date_aware_knowledge
      language: language_and_season
      constraints:
        - "use_only_knowledge_base_info"
        - "no_external_links"
        - "match_customer_language"
    output: raw_draft_response

  - id: step_validate_draft
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_draft_response
      schema: draft_response_schema
    output: validated_draft

  - id: step_format_draft_for_gmail
    op: format_output
    params:
      input: validated_draft
      format: "gmail_draft_json"
      include_fields:
        - "to"
        - "subject"
        - "body_html"
        - "thread_id"
        - "language"
    output: formatted_gmail_draft

  - id: step_create_gmail_draft
    op: call_webhook
    params:
      input: formatted_gmail_draft
      url: "https://www.googleapis.com/gmail/v1/users/me/drafts"
      method: "POST"
      action: "createDraft"
    output: draft_creation_result

  - id: step_handle_draft_error
    op: handle_error
    params:
      step: step_create_gmail_draft
      on_error: step_retry_draft

  - id: step_retry_draft
    op: retry_step
    params:
      step: step_create_gmail_draft
      max_retries: 3
    output: retry_result

  - id: step_log_audit
    op: log_audit
    params:
      input: formatted_gmail_draft
      event: "draft_response_created"
      details:
        email_id: validated_email
        knowledge_bases_searched:
          - "customerSupportDocs"
          - "clubDocuments"
          - "previousEmailResponses"
        language: language_and_season
        draft_id: draft_creation_result

  - id: step_notify_staff
    op: notify_user
    params:
      input: formatted_gmail_draft
      recipient: "support_staff"
      message: "A new AI-drafted response is ready for review in Gmail drafts."
      channel: "email"

  - id: step_terminate
    op: terminate_workflow
    params:
      status: "success"
      message: "Draft response created successfully for staff review."

    op: extract_field
    params:
      input: validated_email
      field: email_body
    output: email_body

  - id: step_extract_thread_history
    op: extract_field
    params:
      input: validated_email
      field: thread_history
    output: thread_history

  - id: step_search_support_docs
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      endpoint: /api/knowledge_base/customerSupportDocs/search
      query_input: email_body
    output: raw_support_docs

  - id: step_validate_support_docs
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_support_docs
      schema: knowledge_base_result_schema
    output: validated_support_docs

  - id: step_search_club_documents
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      endpoint: /api/knowledge_base/clubDocuments/search
      query_input: email_body
    output: raw_club_docs

  - id: step_validate_club_docs
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_club_docs
      schema: knowledge_base_result_schema
    output: validated_club_docs

  - id: step_search_previous_emails
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      endpoint: /api/knowledge_base/previousEmailResponses/search
      query_input: email_body
    output: raw_previous_emails

  - id: step_validate_previous_emails
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_previous_emails
      schema: knowledge_base_result_schema
    output: validated_previous_emails

  - id: step_merge_support_and_club
    op: merge_datasets
    params:
      input: validated_support_docs
      secondary_input: validated_club_docs
      key: topic
    output: merged_support_club

  - id: step_merge_all_sources
    op: merge_datasets
    params:
      input: merged_support_club
      secondary_input: validated_previous_emails
      key: topic
    output: all_knowledge_results

  - id: step_detect_language_and_season
    op: apply_rule
    params:
      input: email_body
      rules:
        - rule: detect_language
          options:
            - EN
            - FR
            - ES
        - rule: season_mapping
          description: map current date to activity season
    output: language_and_season

  - id: step_apply_date_awareness
    op: transform_json
    params:
      input: all_knowledge_results
      mapping:
        date_context: current_date
        filter_current_activities: true
        season_info: language_and_season
    output: date_aware_knowledge

  - id: step_confirm_all_three_sources
    op: apply_rule
    params:
      input: date_aware_knowledge
      rules:
        - rule: require_sources_present
          required_sources:
            - customerSupportDocs
            - clubDocuments
            - previousEmailResponses
    output: source_check_result

  - id: step_route_if_sources_complete
    op: route_to_step
    params:
      input: source_check_result
      condition: all_required_sources_present
      on_true: step_draft_response
      on_false: step_terminate_incomplete_sources

  - id: step_draft_response
    op: call_subworkflow
    params:
      workflow_id: ai_draft_composer
      email_body: email_body
      thread_history: thread_history
      knowledge_context: date_aware_knowledge
      language: language_and_season
      source_validation: source_check_result
      constraints:
        - use_only_knowledge_base_info
        - no_external_links
        - match_customer_language
        - draft_only_after_all_three_searches
    output: raw_draft_response

  - id: step_validate_draft
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_draft_response
      schema: draft_response_schema
    output: validated_draft

  - id: step_format_draft_for_gmail
    op: format_output
    params:
      input: validated_draft
      format: gmail_draft_json
      include_fields:
        - to
        - subject
        - body_html
        - thread_id
        - language
    output: formatted_gmail_draft

  - id: step_create_gmail_draft
    op: call_webhook
    params:
      input: formatted_gmail_draft
      url: https://www.googleapis.com/gmail/v1/users/me/drafts
      method: POST
      action: createDraft
    output: draft_creation_result

  - id: step_handle_draft_error
    op: handle_error
    params:
      step: step_create_gmail_draft
      on_error: step_retry_draft

  - id: step_retry_draft
    op: retry_step
    params:
      step: step_create_gmail_draft
      max_retries: 3
    output: retry_result

  - id: step_extract_draft_id
    op: extract_field
    params:
      input: draft_creation_result
      field: draft_id
    output: safe_draft_id

  - id: step_log_audit
    op: log_audit
    params:
      input: safe_draft_id
      event: draft_response_created
      details:
        knowledge_bases_searched:
          - customerSupportDocs
          - clubDocuments
          - previousEmailResponses
        language: language_and_season

  - id: step_notify_staff
    op: notify_user
    params:
      input: formatted_gmail_draft
      recipient: support_staff
      message: A new AI-drafted response is ready for review in Gmail drafts.
      channel: email

  - id: step_terminate
    op: terminate_workflow
    params:
      status: success
      message: Draft response created successfully for staff review.

  - id: step_terminate_incomplete_sources
    op: terminate_workflow
    params:
      status: failed
      message: All three knowledge bases must be searched and present before drafting.
